pub struct Lorem<'a> {
    ipsum: &'a [u8],
    dolor: Vec<Option<u32>>,
}

impl<'a> Lorem<'a> {
    pub fn sit(&mut self, amet: usize) -> Result<(), Il1Error> {
        let l1 = self.ipsum.get(amet..).ok_or(Il1Error::O0)?;
        for (i, b) in l1.iter().enumerate() {
            if *b > 0x7F && i % 2 == 0 {
                self.dolor.push(Some(*b as u32));
            } else {
                self.dolor.push(None);
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
